notes.title: 🎉 Yeah! It's halftime! 🎉
notes.content:
[p]🎉 Yeah! It's halftime! 🎉 And I am overwhelmed by your amazing support! 😀 Thanks in no small part to YOUR contribution, we have already reached 125% of our campaign goal! Your enthusiasm and trust in my little passion project mean the world to me: ❤️ [url="https://bit.ly/kicksw2"]https://bit.ly/kicksw2[/url][/p][p] [url="https://bit.ly/kicksw2"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45458422/202d8f503f05d2b8634aace0abdcd0e6a7ad48df.png"][/img][/url][/p][p]But this isn't the end. Every additional dollar helps to make the project a little bit better. For example, with high-quality translations 📖 into the most important languages on our planet.   Let's achieve even more together! [/p][p]Please share the campaign, tell your friends about it - and if you can, please continue to support it.   Thank you for being part of this journey! 😍  [/p][p]All the best,
Axel[/p]

notes.title: Kickstarter campaign started!
notes.content: [p]Hello,  I am delighted to announce the launch of the Kickstarter campaign for my point-and-click adventure game “Scott Whiskers: The Search for the Golden Cat”: [/p][p][url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/fancyfactory/scott-whiskers-in-the-search-for-the-golden-cat"]https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/fancyfactory/scott-whiskers-in-the-search-for-the-golden-cat[/url][/p][p] 😀 [/p][p]Fans of this almost forgotten genre now have the opportunity to help the project cross the finish line with a small (or not so small) financial contribution. As a reward, you'll get the game at a substantial discount for the platform of your choice, or a strictly limited “Big Box” edition with the game DRM-free on a USB stick, and packaged in a high-quality cardboard box like in the good old days. Or, if you want to go all in, there's also the “Producer” option for a "few" extra bucks. 🙃  [/p][p]Never heard of “Scott Whiskers: the Search for the Golden Cat”? Well, it's the direct sequel to my adventure game [/p][p][url="https://www.scottwhiskers.com/scott-whiskers-in-the-search-for-mr-fumbleclaw/"]https://www.scottwhiskers.com/scott-whiskers-in-the-search-for-mr-fumbleclaw/[/url][/p][p]  Join Scott Whiskers on the other side of the world in his new adventure and embark on a quest to find a mystical golden cat deep in the jungles of Guatemala. The golden cat is the key to the happiness of a small village - Santo Tomas. And only an expert in missing cats will be up to the task. An expert like Scott Whiskers...  [/p][p]The campaign will run for 30 days until July 22, 2025. And it's THE chance to snag some really rare and strictly limited rewards. Rewards like the already mentioned Bix Box. Or Freddy, a small hand-painted lemur. Or a high-quality fabric map. Or a great “making of” photo book. Or... or... or... 🙂  [/p][p][/p][p]All the best, [/p][p]Axel[/p]

notes.title: Kickstarter campaign starts on June 22!
notes.content: [p]Oh, how wonderful! I am very pleased to announce the launch of the Kickstarter campaign for my upcoming point-and-click adventure game, Scott Whiskers: The Search for the Golden Cat, on [b]June 22[/b]: [url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/fancyfactory/scott-whiskers-in-the-search-for-the-golden-cat/"]https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/fancyfactory/scott-whiskers-in-the-search-for-the-golden-cat/[/url] 😀[/p][p]Pack your bags, scrape together your grandma's  👵 spare change 💰, and make sure Scott Whiskers can set off on his latest adventure with plenty of sun, sand, and sea at the beginning of next year. ☀️  [/p][p]The campaign will run for 30 days and is primarily intended to cover the costs I already had and to finance further translations. I really hope that nothing will stand in the way of a release early next year.  [/p][p]Interested? Then mark [b]June 22[/b] in your calendar in big, bold letters! And don't forget that there is already a (very) extensive demo available here and on GOG that gives you a good insight into what you can expect later in Scott's adventure on the other side of the world.[/p]
